headline: Global Stock Markets Fall on Threat of New Trump Tariffs
summary: World stock markets retreated on Wednesday, weighed down by reports of new US tariff threats and exhaustion in a technology-led rebound.
why: Global equity indexes reflect the combined value of listed companies across major economies, so trade-policy shocks and sector rotations feed directly into broad market performance.
why_moved: Reports of new US tariff threats raised trade-policy uncertainty, and the tech-led rebound appeared to lose momentum.
original_headline: Las bolsas mundiales caen ante la amenaza de nuevos aranceles de Trump
